about: Editorial features (owner authorisation, review 14, 2026-11-24): a separately dated editorial retrospective beside a chapter, never a rewrite of one. Each feature's text is ONE file in this directory, published byte for byte, and bound to ONE SHA-256 here: the build refuses a text that does not hash to it (www/src/lib/feature.js) and scripts/check_www_build.py rebuilds the text from the built page and checks the hash on every build and every deploy scan. Swapping an approved text is two lines: the file and its sha256. `dated` is the editorial writing date inside the text; `first_published` is the actual first-publication day, shown in the page chrome (outside the text) and used as the RSS item's pubDate (scripts/v4_build_rss.py). `path` never changes once published; it is also the RSS item's guid.
